notes: No source edits; isolated linked worktree deliberately detached at exact requested head.
Prior evidence d729ae1fce2544a5d8213460ae7d1f4d6143524c reported toolbar overflow at375px; fresh evidence required for ab0e4936.
No new locale keys; existing labels checked in en/pl/es/de/ko. Existing Korean forms labels remain English.
Initial unscoped native discovery was CPU-bound and stopped without a test result; supported OM_INTEGRATION_MODULES scope completed 24 tests through the authoritative CLI.
First i18n sync invocation hit the host Unix socket path limit; short TMPDIR retry passed.
A local browser harness route-removal race required restarting the browser and resetting passwords only for this run's two synthetic users. No product failure was inferred from harness errors.
A property-only Forms toggle intentionally does not enter structural Undo history. Final Undo/Redo verification used a real pointer-drag structural edit.
Ctrl+Enter on the full-page warranty edit did not issue a retry; dialog keyboard submission was verified separately. Refused full-page edits were retried with Save and verified after Refresh.

findings.title: Metadata save refused with409 still says All changes saved
findings.reproduction: Open same form with own second tenant-bound editor; B changes description and saves. A changes name and autosaves twice using stale updatedAt. Both PATCH requests return409; API retains original name and B description, while header displays All changes saved. Refresh then retry succeeds without losing B changes.
findings.expected: Toolbar must reflect refused or unsaved metadata instead of reporting success.
findings.baseline: persistFormPatch and autosave status rendering are unchanged from d729ae1fce2544a5d8213460ae7d1f4d6143524c; this is not introduced by the toolbar-wrap delta.

coverageLimits: Fault-injected503 and delayed GET checks exercise browser error/loading/recovery; they are not an actual production outage.

Initial fixture creation, bulk line lifecycle setup, whole-record comparisons and direct hidden-action checks used APIs, recorded per step. Header transitions, locale edits, permissions pages, amounts, dialogs, toolbar actions and stale edits used real browser UI.

Stock/money sales bridges, undo/redo/replay, cross-org and tenant isolation were exercised by the shipped native integration tests; sales document/export UI reconciliation and external payment/shipping/email providers were not repeated (no changed runtime integration path).
No workers, webhooks, scheduled jobs or external-provider logic changed in this CSS-only PR. No external credentials or services were used.

No new locale keys were added. Existing keys exist in all en/pl/es/de/ko files; default English and Polish plus German/Spanish screens checked. Korean layout was checked with its existing English Forms fallback; this does not claim completed Korean translation.
No source edits, source-branch pushes/merges, shared QA metadata, QA approval/failure/pipeline labels or human-assignment changes.
